questions.stem: Which of the following is a characteristic of an element?
choices: It is made up of two or more types of atoms
All the atoms in an element are the same
It can be broken down into simpler substances by chemical means
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'All the atoms in an element are the same' because an element is defined as a pure substance consisting of only one type of atom. The other options are incorrect because elements cannot be broken down into simpler substances by chemical means, they have a fixed composition, and they are made up of only one type of atom, not two or more.

hi.critique: The translation is accurate and maintains the original meaning, with appropriate Hindi scientific terminology.

questions.stem: What is the main difference between elements and compounds?
choices: Elements consist of two or more types of atoms, while compounds consist of only one type of atom.
Elements are made up of only one type of atom, while compounds are made up of two or more types of atoms.
Elements can be broken down into simpler substances, while compounds cannot.
Elements have a fixed composition, while compounds can have variable composition.
questions.solution: The correct answer is that elements are made up of only one type of atom, while compounds are made up of two or more types of atoms. This is because elements are pure substances composed of only one kind of atom, while compounds are formed when two or more different elements combine chemically in a fixed ratio. The other options are incorrect because elements cannot be broken down into simpler substances, and compounds have a fixed composition, not variable.

तत्व केवल एक प्रकार के परमाणु से बने होते हैं, जबकि यौगिक दो या अधिक प्रकार के परमाणु से बने होते हैं।
तत्वों को सरल पदार्थों में विभाजित किया जा सकता है, जबकि यौगिकों को नहीं।
तत्वों का संघटन निश्चित होता है, जबकि यौगिकों का संघटन चर होता है।

questions.stem: Which of the following is a method used to write the molecular formula of a compound?

Using the atomic mass of elements
Calculating the volume of the compound

questions.solution: The correct method is to write the symbols of elements and their valencies, as this directly relates to determining how atoms combine in a compound. Using atomic mass, volume, or temperature does not provide information about how elements bond or the ratio of atoms in a molecule.

questions.stem: What is the basis for deducing the valency of elements from the molecular formula of a compound?
questions.solution: The basis is the univalency of hydrogen, as hydrogen typically forms one bond in compounds. This allows scientists to determine the valency of other elements by counting how many hydrogen atoms they bond with. Other elements like oxygen, carbon, or nitrogen do not have a consistent univalency that can be used as a universal reference.

hi.stem: किस तत्व के अणुसूत्र से तत्वों की संयोजकता का निष्कर्ष कैसे निकाला जाता है?

questions.stem: Which of the following is a homogeneous mixture?
questions.solution: A homogeneous mixture has a uniform composition throughout. Salt solution is a homogeneous mixture because the salt is completely dissolved in water and cannot be seen as separate particles. A suspension is heterogeneous as the particles settle down. A colloid is also heterogeneous because the particles are not visible but scatter light. Iron and sulphur are not a mixture but a physical combination of two elements.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक समांगी मिश्रण है?
hi.solution: एक समांगी मिश्रण का संघटन पूरे भाग में समान होता है। नमक का घोल समांगी मिश्रण है क्योंकि नमक पूरी तरह से पानी में घुल जाता है और अलग कण के रूप में दिखाई नहीं देता। अवक्षेपण असमांगी होता है क्योंकि कण नीचे बैठ जाते हैं। कोलॉइड भी असमांगी होता है क्योंकि कण दिखाई नहीं देते लेकिन प्रकाश को बिखेर देते हैं। लोहा एवं सल्फर एक मिश्रण नहीं हैं बल्कि दो तत्वों का भौतिक संयोजन है।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Hindi scientific terminology.

mr.stem: खालीलपैकी कोणते एक समजातीय मिश्रण आहे?
mr.solution: समजातीय मिश्रणाची एकसारखी रचना असते. खारा द्रावण हे समजातीय मिश्रण आहे कारण खारा पाण्यात पूर्णपणे विरघळलेला असतो आणि त्याचे कण अलग दिसत नाहीत. रॉयल विलय हे विजातीय आहे कारण त्याचे कण खाली पडतात. कोलॉइड देखील विजातीय आहे कारण त्याचे कण दिसत नाहीत परंतु प्रकाश बिखरतात. लोह आणि सल्फर हे मिश्रण नसून दोन घटकांचे भौमितिक संयोजन आहे.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate and maintains the technical terminology used in Marathi science education.

questions.stem: What is the term for the component of a solution that is present in the largest proportion?
questions.solution: The solvent is the component of a solution that is present in the largest proportion. The other components, called solutes, are present in smaller amounts. A compound is a substance made of two or more elements chemically combined, while a mixture is a physical combination of substances.

hi.stem: एक विलयन के घटक का क्या नाम होता है जो सबसे बड़ी मात्रा में उपस्थित होता है?

questions.stem: If a substance decomposes on heating and leaves behind a residue, what type of compound is it likely to be?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'Inorganic compound' because inorganic compounds often decompose when heated and leave behind a residue, which is a characteristic of their structure. Organic compounds usually burn completely without leaving a residue, and elements are not compounds, so they cannot decompose in this way. Complex compounds are not typically associated with residue formation upon heating.

hi.stem: यदि कोई पदार्थ गर्म करने पर विघटित हो जाता है और एक अवशेष छोड़ देता है, तो यह किस प्रकार का यौगिक होने की संभावना है?
hi.solution: सही उत्तर 'अकार्बनिक यौगिक' है क्योंकि अकार्बनिक यौगिक गर्म करने पर विघटित हो जाते हैं और एक अवशेष छोड़ देते हैं, जो इनकी संरचना की विशेषता है। कार्बनिक यौगिक आमतौर पर पूरी तरह जल जाते हैं बिना किसी अवशेष के, और तत्व यौगिक नहीं होते, इसलिए इनमें इस तरह विघटन संभव नहीं है। जटिल यौगिक गर्म करने पर अवशेष बनाने से जुड़े नहीं होते।
hi.critique: Translation accurately reflects the original meaning with appropriate Hindi scientific terminology.

mr.stem: एका द्रव्याने उष्णतेमुळे विघटन होते आणि त्यानंतर अवशेष राहतो, तर ते द्रव्य कोणत्या प्रकारचे यौगिक असण्याची शक्यता आहे?
mr.solution: बरोबर उत्तर 'अकार्बनिक यौगिक' आहे कारण अकार्बनिक यौगिक उष्णतेमुळे विघटन होतात आणि अवशेष राहतो, हे त्यांच्या संरचनेची वैशिष्ट्ये आहे. कार्बनिक यौगिक अत्यंत ज्वलन करतात आणि अवशेष राहत नाहीत, आणि तत्त्व यौगिक नसतात, म्हणून ते अशा प्रकारे विघटन होऊ शकत नाहीत. जटिल यौगिक उष्णतेमुळे अवशेष निर्माण करण्याशी संबंधित नसतात.

questions.stem: Which of the following can be separated by filtration?
questions.solution: Filtration is used to separate a solid from a liquid when the solid does not dissolve in the liquid. Iron and sulphur mixture can be separated by filtration because the solid particles of iron and sulphur remain on the filter paper. Milk and chlorinated water are colloids, which cannot be separated by filtration. Salt solution is a homogeneous mixture and passes through the filter paper.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा फिल्टर करके अलग किया जा सकता है?
hi.solution: फिल्टर करके तब अलग किया जाता है जब ठोस तरल में घुल जाता है। लोहा एवं सल्फर के मिश्रण को फिल्टर करके अलग किया जा सकता है क्योंकि लोहा एवं सल्फर के ठोस कण फिल्टर पेपर पर रह जाते हैं। दूध एवं क्लोरीन युक्त पानी कोलॉइड हैं जिन्हें फिल्टर करके अलग नहीं किया जा सकता। नमक के घोल एक समांगी मिश्रण है जो फिल्टर पेपर से गुजर जाता है।
hi.critique: Translation is accurate and maintains the scientific meaning, with appropriate Hindi terminology used for chemical concepts.

mr.stem: खालीलपैकी कोणते फिल्टरिंगद्वारे विलग करता येईल?
mr.solution: फिल्टरिंग हे द्रवापासून घन वस्तू विलग करण्यासाठी वापरले जाते जेव्हा घन वस्तू द्रावणात विरघळत नाही. लोह आणि सल्फरचे मिश्रण फिल्टरिंगद्वारे विलग करता येते कारण लोह आणि सल्फरच्या घन कणांनी फिल्टर कागदावर राहतात. दूध आणि क्लोरिनेटेड पाणी असे कोलॉइड आहेत जे फिल्टरिंगद्वारे विलग करता येत नाहीत. खारा द्रावण हे समजावून घेतलेले मिश्रण आहे आणि फिल्टर कागदातून जाते.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Marathi scientific terminology.

questions.stem: What is the correct molecular formula for a compound formed between calcium (valency 2) and oxygen (valency 2)?
questions.solution: The correct molecular formula is CaO because calcium and oxygen each have a valency of 2, meaning they combine in a 1:1 ratio to form a neutral compound. Ca2O2 and CaO2 suggest incorrect ratios that would not balance the charges, while Ca2O would leave oxygen with an unbalanced charge.

hi.stem: कैल्शियम (संयोजकता 2) और ऑक्सीजन (संयोजकता 2) के बीच बने यौगिक का सही अणुसूत्र क्या है?
hi.solution: सही अणुसूत्र CaO है क्योंकि कैल्शियम और ऑक्सीजन की संयोजकता 2 है, जिसका अर्थ है कि वे एक उदासीन यौगिक बनाने के लिए 1:1 अनुपात में संयोजित होते हैं। Ca2O2 और CaO2 गलत अनुपात का सुझाव देते हैं जो आवेशों को संतुलित नहीं करेंगे, जबकि Ca2O ऑक्सीजन के आवेश को संतुलित नहीं करेगा।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate scientific terminology as used in Hindi-medium textbooks.

mr.stem: कॅल्शियम (संयोजकता 2) आणि ऑक्सीजन (संयोजकता 2) दरम्यान बनलेल्या यौगिकाचे योग्य अणुसूत्र काय आहे?
mr.solution: योग्य अणुसूत्र CaO आहे कारण कॅल्शियम आणि ऑक्सीजन दोन्ही संयोजकता 2 असल्यामुळे ते एका 1:1 गुणोत्तरात एकत्र येऊन निरपेक्ष यौगिक बनवतात. Ca2O2 आणि CaO2 अयोग्य गुणोत्तरांचा सूचित करतात जे आवेश निरसन करणार नाहीत, तर Ca2O ऑक्सीजनला असंतुलित आवेश देईल.

questions.stem: In the experiment with iron filings and sulphur, what was observed when the mixture was heated?
choices: It became attracted to a magnet
It changed colour and lost its magnetic properties
questions.solution: When the mixture of iron filings and sulphur was heated, it formed a new compound, iron sulphide. The colour changed from a mix of black and yellow to a uniform black, and the magnetic properties of iron were lost. This shows that a chemical reaction occurred, forming a compound with different properties from the original elements.

hi.stem: लोहे के चूर्ण और सल्फर के प्रयोग में, मिश्रण को गर्म करने पर क्या अवलोकन किया गया?

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is true about a colloid?
choices: It can be separated by filtration
Its particles are smaller than 10 micrometers
questions.solution: A colloid is a heterogeneous mixture. Its particles are larger than a solution but smaller than a suspension. They scatter light, making the mixture translucent. Filtration cannot separate a colloid. The correct answer is that it is translucent.

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes the difference between a compound and a mixture?
choices: A compound can be separated by physical means, while a mixture cannot
A mixture has a fixed composition, while a compound does not
The components of a compound are chemically combined, while those of a mixture are not
A compound is always a solid, while a mixture can be any state of matter
questions.solution: In a compound, the elements are chemically combined in a fixed ratio, while in a mixture, the components are physically mixed and not chemically bonded. This means the components of a compound cannot be separated by physical means, unlike those in a mixture. A compound has a definite composition, while a mixture can vary. A compound is not always a solid.

questions.stem: Why can a colloid not be separated by filtration?
choices: Because its particles are too small to be seen
Because its particles are too large to pass through the filter paper
Because it is a homogeneous mixture
